Class SparSession

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.SparSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentSession
final class SparSession extends Object implements AgentSession
The user fights the trained network themselves. The network plays the fake player on the integrated server (see BotPilot); this side only starts it, keeps the score and stops it. The player keeps their own mouse, keys, settings and view throughout.
